name: HOOK
thought: Tail snatched a banana, no sweat.

wants.item: A reflective surface to showcase the tail loop
A wider slab for a smoother pogo
A reflective chrome disc to showcase tail loops

diary.line: Swinging over the floating stepping-stones while the crystal glows above; toothpick feels sharp enough to slice through air itself.
Sipped espresso on the ledge, then looped my tail around the telescope tripod and backflipped into the hammock. The hut antenna never noticed. The hammock did.
I pried the unit open, tail snagged the latch and a secret lounge flickered to life, lights buzzing low-poly style.
Got myself stuck on a branch with just three little bananas; they're looking like snack bait compared to the fruit stump I usually steal from.
Wasted an hour showing off on a string thinner than my ego; the grid blinked when I should have been looped tight and ready to pop.
Tail-snagged a mango off the stump while the fan notes rolled in. CRT flickers. Rug's worn. Still the best seat in the grid.
I slipped onto a glassy slab beside the cascade, the surface catching my sunglasses, and I let the tail coil around a jutting rock, testing its grip.
I perched on a drifting sky slab, let the tail tip bounce like a metronome while the espresso steam curled around my sunglasses.
I vaulted over the rope, landed on the hut's balcony, tail curled around the antenna, and eyed the empty espresso cup for a quick sip.
I looped my tail around the fresh rail, tightened the knot, and mounted a low‑poly lantern on the Hang Tree. The glow catches my shades, perfect for the next show‑off.
Sipped the last of the espresso while watching the neon sign flicker. That purple arcade cabinet looks cooler than any tree, but my tail won't loop tight enough on this thin...
I swung into the grove, looped my tail around a ripe banana, yanked it clean, and tipped my toothpick in triumph.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
